title: Feature lifecycle
summary: The stages a feature moves through, from raw material to delivery. Each workflow names the stage it serves in its routing block, so a new workflow appears under its stage without anything here changing. Stages can be skipped.

stages.title: Discover
stages.question: What problems do people actually have?

stages.title: Shape
stages.question: What do we intend to do about it, and is it ready to commit to?

stages.title: Decide
stages.question: What is still open, and who decides?

stages.title: Deliver
stages.question: Will it land when we said, and what moved?
